title: Lock down and fix the pg_cron payout-retry job

requirements.expectation: anon and authenticated cannot EXECUTE set_cron_secret(text,text), install_payout_retry_cron(), payout_retry_cron_status() or pairing_sweep() (when present); service_role can.
requirements.verification: Migration CI privilege assertions (has_function_privilege) on a fresh full replay.
evidence: Local, 2026-11-21, Postgres 16.15 with stub cron/net schemas mirroring the real signatures (pg_net: url, body, params, headers, timeout_milliseconds): after 087, `set role anon` gets 'permission denied' for set_cron_secret, install_payout_retry_cron, payout_retry_cron_status and pairing_sweep (stub); before 087 has_function_privilege('anon', ...) was true for all three 067 functions and pairing_sweep. CI assertions added for the four 087 signatures.

requirements.expectation: The scheduled command calls net.http_post with named arguments and sends Authorization: Bearer <secret> in headers, not in params.
requirements.verification: Migration CI: install with seeded config, then assert cron.job.command contains 'headers :=' and no literal secret; confirm the pg_net signature in CI.
evidence: Local, 2026-11-21, Postgres 16.15 with stub cron/net schemas mirroring the real signatures (pg_net: url, body, params, headers, timeout_milliseconds): the old 067 command, executed, delivered params={Content-Type, Authorization: Bearer old-secret-123} and headers={Content-Type} only. The 087 stored command delivered params={} and headers={Content-Type, Authorization: Bearer dev-secret-abc}. CI pins net.http_post argument names (url, ..., params, headers) on real pg_net.

requirements.expectation: The job URL comes from ona_cron_config.payout_retry_url (https origin only), read at each run; no hard-coded host remains; install returns needs_url without it and refuses a non-https or path-bearing value.
evidence: Local, 2026-11-21, Postgres 16.15 with stub cron/net schemas mirroring the real signatures (pg_net: url, body, params, headers, timeout_milliseconds): install returns needs_url without a URL; set_cron_secret rejects http://, a path, a trailing slash, credentials, a query, an empty host and a bare host (SQLSTATE 22023); stored command has no host and calls https://ona-dev-app.vercel.app/api/payments/payout-retry from config; secret rotation applied on the next run with no reinstall.

requirements.expectation: An existing ona-payout-retry job is unscheduled on migrate and reinstalled only when URL and secret are both configured.
evidence: Local, 2026-11-21, Postgres 16.15 with stub cron/net schemas mirroring the real signatures (pg_net: url, body, params, headers, timeout_milliseconds): with the 067 job installed and no URL seeded, applying 087 left 0 ona-payout-retry jobs.

requirements.expectation: payout_retry_cron_status() reports job, schedule, active, url and whether a secret is configured, never the secret.
requirements.verification: Migration CI assertion on the returned JSON.
evidence: Local, 2026-11-21, Postgres 16.15 with stub cron/net schemas mirroring the real signatures (pg_net: url, body, params, headers, timeout_milliseconds): status returns {jobs, payout_retry_url, payout_retry_secret_configured}; CI asserts the secret never appears in it.

requirements.expectation: The migration applies cleanly where pg_cron or pg_net is absent.
requirements.verification: Source inspection of extension guards; CI applies with extensions present.
evidence: Local, 2026-11-21, Postgres 16.15 with stub cron/net schemas mirroring the real signatures (pg_net: url, body, params, headers, timeout_milliseconds): on a database without cron/net (067 applies only partially there, its sql status function needs cron.job), 087 applied cleanly; install returned needs_pg_cron after URL and secret were seeded; status returned jobs {}.

requirements.expectation: VERCEL_DEPLOY.md has the pg_cron setup steps; MUTATION_INVENTORY.md and BACKEND_FIXES_STATUS.md are updated.
evidence: Source, 2026-11-21: VERCEL_DEPLOY.md 'pg_cron jobs (Supabase)' section, MUTATION_INVENTORY.md payout-retry rows, BACKEND_FIXES_STATUS.md section.

requirements.expectation: Full test suite, typecheck, lint and migration CI pass.
requirements.verification: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test; GitHub 'Fresh Supabase migrations' job.
evidence: Local, 2026-11-21 on uncommitted fix/pg-cron-payout-lockdown (from dev 9dd0077): vitest 284 files / 2,840 tests pass (incl. migration-ci.test.ts); tsc --noEmit passes; eslint 0 errors, 142 warnings. The 087 CI assertion block passed on the stub database, left no job or config rows, and failed on a 067-only database. GitHub migration CI with real pg_cron/pg_net pending.

requirements.expectation: On the dev Supabase project: anon RPC to the cron functions is refused; after seeding payout_retry_url=https://ona-dev-app.vercel.app and the secret, net._http_response shows 200 from payout-retry.
requirements.verification: Anon RPC probe; SQL editor queries on cron.job, cron.job_run_details and net._http_response.
evidence: 2026-11-21, before the fix: anon RPC payout_retry_cron_status() succeeded and returned []; ona_cron_config was empty (no job, no secret).

code: Independent review against the implementation commit.
GitHub 'Fresh Supabase migrations' run with real pg_cron and pg_net (confirms the net.http_post argument order, privileges and install behaviour).
external: Apply migration 087 to the dev Supabase project.
Enable pg_cron and pg_net; seed payout_retry_secret (= CRON_SECRET on ona-dev-app) and payout_retry_url=https://ona-dev-app.vercel.app; run install_payout_retry_cron().
Confirm net._http_response shows 200 from payout-retry and that an anon-key RPC to the cron functions is refused.
Production: same steps with the production host and secret, as a separate rollout.
